section.title: Branch Tree
section.p: The tree groups branches under and nodes. Every configured remote appears under , including remotes that you have not fetched from yet. Hovering a branch shows its last commit's author and date, and hovering a remote shows its URL. Opening the view or using fetches in the background. Right-click the node to fetch all remotes or a single remote such as origin.
Two markers indicate when the fetch configuration limits what the tree can show:

dlentry.dd: On a remote, this means its fetch configuration downloads only some of its branches. The tooltip lists the configuration. Select to download all of them from now on.

On a local branch, this means the branch tracks a remote branch that is not downloaded, so the Git Client cannot determine locally whether that remote branch is still available or how far ahead or behind you are. Select to add the upstream branches tracked by your local branches to the fetch configuration.
